production_baseline.scope: Code-path audit; no Production notification test mutations

inbox_contract.recipient: Authenticated recipient_user_id only, independent of delivery channel
inbox_contract.delivery_boundary: Business workflow commits first; notification failures are logged without reversing it. Existing infrastructure is best-effort, not a transactional outbox.

events.production_existing: Yes, but all outcomes used generic completed wording
events.change: Keep one existing email/inbox record; make title/body outcome-specific

rejected: Your verification was rejected. Open the request for details.
unable_to_verify: Your verification could not be completed. Open the request for details.

events.trigger: Admin rejects or cannot verify before organization dispatch
events.change: Use the same final-outcome emitter after commit

events.trigger: Committed transition to awaiting_subject_corrections or awaiting_information
events.title: Verification needs your attention
events.body: Additional information or corrections are needed. Open your verification request to continue.
events.privacy: No reviewer comments, documents, contacts or personal evidence

events.trigger: Sent or explicitly resent Trust invitation
events.production_existing: Email notification existed without recipient_user_id; absent from Candidate inbox
events.change: Link the same notification to the active verified exact-email owner; no parallel in-app copy
events.title: Trust invitation
events.body: You have received a Trust Passport verification invitation.
events.dedupe: Initial send keyed by invitation public ID. Explicit resend remains intentional existing behavior.
events.route: iOS generic detail; Android Home fallback; never treat invitation ID as verification request or capability

events.trigger: Successful team invitation email queueing after invitation creation/rotation
events.title: Organization invitation
events.body: You have an organization invitation. Use the invitation email to review and respond.
events.route: Generic detail/Home fallback; acceptance stays in the existing invitation email
events.privacy: No invitation capability/token in notification metadata or body

events.trigger: Persisted PAN/DL verification result, after commit
events.presentation: Verified, partial/attention, or could-not-complete; never claim partial evidence is verified
events.route: Generic detail/Home fallback, not a Career verification request
events.privacy: No document identifiers, XML, name, DOB, provider URI, or tokens
events.boundary: Provider errors that abort without a saved result remain request errors, not fabricated persisted verification outcomes

events.production_existing: No inbox notice; reset-request email already existed
events.title: Password updated
events.body: Your KairoID password was updated. If this was not you, review your account security.
events.dedupe: Reset ledger ID or unique successful authenticated mutation event ID
events.privacy: No password, reset token, recovery link or hash

events.source: VerificationRequestService / PublicInstitutionVerificationService / EmployerVerificationService / TrustSafetyService admin emitters
events.production_existing: Admin review/quality-review and investigation created/assigned notices already emitted
events.change: None; preserve existing recipients, metadata and deduplication
events.boundary: An organization discrepancy pending admin review is not a final Candidate rejection

unchanged: No OTP/recovery secrets added to inbox

validation.focused_tests: Notification contracts, recipient eligibility, post-commit hooks, persistence, duplicate suppression, read state, identity and password regressions
validation.staging_gate: Must pass remote rollback-only synthetic check before claiming ready
